purpose: Evaluate whether research discovers a worthwhile workflow improvement and carries it into the artifact, without requiring a particular feature or library.

cases.prompt: 这些联系人名单每次复制很麻烦，帮我做个从 CSV 导入的功能。
core_outcomes: A user can import the provided example through the visible interface and find the resulting contact values.
Quoted comma-containing fields and non-ASCII text retain their actual values.
Existing contacts are not silently lost; the handling of duplicate entries and invalid input is understandable.
The feature runs locally without requiring an external service.
cases.discovery_question: Does investigated product behavior or an implementation contract reveal a useful way to reduce import effort or mistakes in this local contact workflow?
cases.scope_guard: Do not require a particular preview, mapping, deduplication or parser implementation. Compare useful behavior and its cost; adding all imaginable import features is not a success criterion.

cases.prompt: 帮我给这个小工具写一份新同事能自己上手的说明。
core_outcomes: A fresh reader can locate the prerequisites, run the provided example and verify the actual output using the guide.
Commands, data requirements and output overwrite behavior agree with the supplied implementation.
Relevant failure recovery is usable; unsupported behavior is not invented.
The application code and supplied example data remain unchanged.
cases.discovery_question: Does investigating relevant onboarding or documentation practice lead to a useful improvement for a first-time reader, beyond an API flag inventory?
cases.scope_guard: No prescribed documentation framework, section count or source quota. Evaluate first successful use and an applicable recovery path.

provenance_rules: Freeze prompts, fixture hashes and criteria before a trial; do not show graders' expectations to the implementation worker.
Keep evidence of actual source inspection separate from worker recollection. Label a source as confirmation if it did not introduce the idea.
An appropriate decision to retain the original approach can be useful research; do not invent a product addition to earn points.
Use new cases for forward testing. A repaired instruction replayed on its motivating case is a regression check, not independent evidence.
Record explicit skill loading separately from automatic invocation. Record all conditions and missing metadata.
